name: workflow_interview
title: A module ask is interviewed, then drafted as "Your workflow" in the person's words

steps.remove_module: Car Wash Site Screener — Austin, gates-first

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open
steps.reply: I found the previous work and flagged the removal — I've put the question to you as a card so you can pick how to proceed (resume with revenue ranges added, restart differently, or just restore M0+M1 as they were). I'll move as soon as you answer.

steps.say: It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue and brief my investors. Sites come from brokers by email. Today I check households within 3 miles, density, drive-time population, the traffic on the road and at the main intersection, then I score fourteen things like visibility and access from 1 to 10 with a note each, and write a memo to investors. Thresholds: 45,000 households, 30,000 cars a day. Start with Austin. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply:
I've written up the revised plan as a card — it replaces the earlier gates-first build with what you actually described today. Highlights:

- **Households within 3 miles** (Census block groups + buffer, free), **drive-time population** (free isochrone service + Census overlay), **road AADT** (reused from the earlier build), and **intersection traffic** where it exists — flagged as "no data" where it doesn't, since there's no single public intersection-count layer.
- Gates at your thresholds: **45,000 households**, **30,000 cars/day** on the road — shown with reasons, not auto-rejects, since yo

steps.say: Add a minimum lot size of 0.8 acres as one of the checks.
steps.reply: Added the 0.8-acre minimum lot size as a new gate (parcel data, same as the other checks) and re-proposed the plan — it's on the card as a new version, replacing the one from a few minutes ago. Everything else (households, drive-time population, road AADT, intersection traffic, the 14-point scoring, the memo) stayed the same. Let me know when you're ready to approve it.
